test_title: PYST 17: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 28 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

_ A A _ F _ A N F A _ _ _ A A N

options.text: F A A F N A
A A F F N A
F A N A N F
F N A A N F

solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: _ A A _ F _ A N F A _ _ _ A A N 

Now, put the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) F A A F N A → __**F**__ A A __**A**__ / F __**A**__** **A N / F A __**F**__** **__**N**__** / **__**A**__** **A A N 

Option 2) A A F F N A → __**A**__ A A __**A**__ / F __**F**__ A N / F A __F__ __N__ / __A__ A A N 

Option 3) F A N A N F → __F__ A A __A__ / F __N__ A N / F A __A__ __N__ / __F__ A A N 

Option 4) F N A A N F → __F__ A A __N__ / F __A__ A N / F A __A__ __N__ / __F__ A A N 

Here, '**FAAN**' followed a pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option(4)".
